slides.title: Russia-Ukraine prisoner swap
slides.image_prompt: Two empty chairs facing each other across a long polished table in a bright conference room, an open door between them, soft morning light
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Abu Dhabi talks ended with a deal to swap prisoners.
WHY IT MATTERS
First talks in nine months; no ceasefire breakthrough.
FOR YOU
Prisoner numbers get set Thursday, when US envoys also meet Putin in Moscow.
slides.body: Abu Dhabi talks ended with a deal to swap prisoners. First talks in nine months; no ceasefire breakthrough. Prisoner numbers get set Thursday, when US envoys also meet Putin in Moscow.

slides.title: Rubio: no major Iran combat
slides.image_prompt: A chessboard with pieces paused mid-game on a wooden table, an oil barrel and a sealed envelope beside it, dim neutral light
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Rubio: economic pressure works, so no major Iran combat.
WHY IT MATTERS
Iran says no talks with the US are happening.
FOR YOU
No major US combat planned for now, but Rubio says the military stands ready.
slides.body: Rubio: economic pressure works, so no major Iran combat. Iran says no talks with the US are happening. No major US combat planned for now, but Rubio says the military stands ready.

slides.title: Spain strikes over housing
slides.image_prompt: A row of Spanish apartment balconies with closed shutters above an empty bus stop on a quiet street, soft morning light
slides.label: ECONOMY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Spain's biggest unions called a 24-hour nationwide strike.
WHY IT MATTERS
First in 14 years, weeks before the 29 November election.
FOR YOU
In Spain today? Expect disrupted public transport. Housing is now a key election issue.
slides.body: Spain's biggest unions called a 24-hour nationwide strike. First in 14 years, weeks before the 29 November election. In Spain today? Expect disrupted public transport. Housing is now a key election issue.

slides.title: US inflation beats forecasts
slides.image_prompt: A shopping basket full of groceries beside a stack of coins and a red paper arrow pointing upward on a kitchen counter
slides.label: ECONOMY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
US prices rose 0.4% in October, above the 0.3% forecast.
WHY IT MATTERS
Markets now see a December rate hike as almost certain.
FOR YOU
If the Fed hikes on 8–9 December, US borrowing will likely get pricier.
slides.body: US prices rose 0.4% in October, above the 0.3% forecast. Markets now see a December rate hike as almost certain. If the Fed hikes on 8–9 December, US borrowing will likely get pricier.

slides.title: Climate summit hits Antalya
slides.image_prompt: A sunny Mediterranean coastline with wind turbines and solar panels on green hills above a calm turquoise sea
slides.label: SCIENCE
points: WHAT HAPPENED
The COP31 UN climate summit is under way in Antalya.
WHY IT MATTERS
The UN expects over 90,000 attendees through 20 November.
FOR YOU
Erdoğan hopes it will be a 'COP of implementation'. Watch what actually gets delivered.
slides.body: The COP31 UN climate summit is under way in Antalya. The UN expects over 90,000 attendees through 20 November. Erdoğan hopes it will be a 'COP of implementation'. Watch what actually gets delivered.
